strategies.entry_summary: In a descending channel (NQ afternoon), after bulls fail to push up off the 50 moving average and reject with a weak close, wait for a bar to close under the blue 25 EMA. Enter short on that confirmation candle, anticipating a channel break to the downside and another leg down.
strategies.exit_summary: Add a second contract on a pullback; move stop to break-even if price does not move away from the entry within a reasonable time; kill the trade if a bar closes back above the 25 EMA / breaks the channel up. Target a measured move (roughly the same size as the first down-leg) and exit at the bottom level.
strategies.name: channel_break_25ema_close_short
